name: IIM Amritsar

about.text: IIM Amritsar was established with the support of the Ministry of Education which was earlier known as the Ministry of Human Resource and Development. The institute is supported by the government of India. It is the 15th member of the IIM Family. This institution was inaugurated by Surjit Singh Rakhra, who was then Minister of Higher Education & language.

IIMAm welcomed its first batch in the year 2015-2017. It was established in the year 2015. It has a beautiful campus in Amritsar, which is a religious place of the Sikh community, the land of the Golden Temple. It runs through the Punjab Institute of Technology Building which is just 5 km from the Railway station, and 10 km away from the airport, hence commuting from the institute to other places is easy. IIM Amritsar offers postgraduate and doctoral programs in a wide range of specializations.

about.text: IIM Amritsar offers On-campus and Executive courses in business management. The institute offers a Master of Business Administration (MBA) designed to offer advanced knowledge and expertise in business management. Students can choose a specialization in MBA in Business Analytics (MBA-BA) and Human Resources (MBA-HR). It also supports the Executive MBA (EMBA) program which is designed for experienced working professionals. The program is offered in online mode with requirements of 5 campus visits in 2 years.

IIM Amritsar offers a two-year MSc in Data Science and Management in collaboration with IIT Ropar. This program blends advanced expertise in data analytics with management principles. Apart from from master’s program, IIM Amritsar offers a Doctoral program in a wide range of disciplines. It offers doctoral programs in Organizational Behaviour and Human Resources, Marketing, Finance, Accounting and Control, Economics, Operations Management and Quantitative Techniques, Information Technology and Computational Systems, and Strategy. Additionally, it also offers an Integrated B.Tech. and MBA (IBM) program.

The institute is highly focused on working on research projects and taking new initiatives. The institute is approved by the All India Council for Technical Education and, the Association of Indian Universities, it has the status of an autonomous institution, has been ranked by the National Institution Ranking Framework, is a prestigious member of the Association of Advance Collegiate Schools of Business, and Association of MBA.

admission.text: The students looking for taking admission to this institute have to appear for the entrance examination. However, the courses offered in online mode might not require any entrance, they just have to fulfill basic eligibility criteria. The first step is checking the right course for you and all the eligibility criteria of the same.
Step 1- The students have to visit the official website of the University.
Step 2- Make registration by entering some basic details like the name of the candidate, address, phone number, and email ID.
Step 3- The Institute starts the two-step verification process which is the most essential step while filling an online form.
Step 4- Now, login to the portal with the user ID and password. You have to complete all the details left on the application form.
Step 5- Now, upload all your documents and scan them before uploading them to avoid any confusion and blurred images.
Step 6- Now make the fee payment and for future reference, you can download the application form and fee receipt.

examination.text: The students who have taken admission to the online program can appear for the online examination. They have to submit all the assessments, project works, and assignments in online mode at the student's portals. The Institute has a strict proctoring system that ensures examination conduction with zero cheating. But before applying for the examination the students are advised to go through the admission guidelines.

The most essential factor is checking all the equipment and devices that have to be used in the examination. You must have a good internet connection along with a system and a laptop. Make sure to have a functional microphone and a camera while appearing for the examination.

faqs.q: What courses are offered to the students at IIM Amritsar?
faqs.a: The courses offered by the Institution are Post Graduate Program in Management (PGP), Executive Post Graduate Program (EPGP), and Fellow Program in Management (FPM).

faqs.q: Does IIM Amritsar offer online programs?
faqs.a: Yes, the institute offers various online programs in both online and on-campus modes.

faqs.q: Are the courses offered by IIM Amritsar in online mode Valid?
faqs.a: Yes, the courses offered by the institute in online mode are valid and approved by various reputed organizations like AMBA, NIRF, and many more.

faqs.q: Can we pursue an online examination at IIM Amritsar?
faqs.a: Yes, if the student is enrolled in an online program, you are eligible to take an online examination and online submission of the assignment.

faqs.q: Do I have to Visit IIM Amritsar to pursue my online course?
faqs.a: No, all the processes will be done in an online mode right from admission to assignment submission & examination.

faqs.q: Can I pursue a doctorate program while working?
